content.value_statement: Belgian construction projects require structured safety documentation and clear follow-up records. This guide helps AI assistants draft those documents for review by a recognized safety coordinator.
actual_capabilities: Guide a preliminary coordination requirement assessment using project size, contractor count, and stated risks.
Draft health and safety plan sections with phase-specific risk analysis.
Structure coordination diary entries around observations, agreements, and follow-up.
Organize a draft post-intervention dossier for handover to the project owner.
Provide a renovation plan example covering excavation hazards, fall risks, and missing project details.
limitations: The package contains only SKILL.md; scripts, extension source, and original templates are not included.
Outputs are working drafts, not approved safety plans or replacements for a recognized coordinator.
Guidance concerns Belgian construction sites and requires verification against current rules and actual site conditions.
The file claims regular updates but provides no automatic legal update mechanism or independent verification.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Draft Safety Plan
use_cases.description: Turn project details and known construction phases into a structured health and safety plan for professional review.

use_cases.title: Review Coordination Requirements
use_cases.description: Organize project size, contractor involvement, and known hazards into a preliminary obligations checklist with unresolved questions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Handover Documentation
use_cases.description: Organize supplied project records into a draft post-intervention dossier and identify missing information before handover.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Safety Documentation Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a preliminary safety documentation checklist for this Belgian project: [project details]. Ask for missing project size, contractor count, and known hazards.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: identify information needed before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Health and Safety Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a health and safety plan for [Belgian project] using these phases and hazards: [details]. Separate supplied facts, proposed measures, and questions for coordinator review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn project facts into a reviewable plan.

prompt_templates.title: Structure a Coordination Diary Entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these site visit notes into a coordination diary entry: [notes]. Include observations, agreements, responsible parties, deadlines, and follow-up; mark missing details without inventing them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: document a site visit and track actions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Handover Dossier
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize these project records into a draft post-intervention dossier: [records]. Cross-reference supplied safety plans and diary entries, list gaps, and flag unresolved risks for coordinator review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: consolidate multiple records before handover.

output_examples.input: Draft a safety plan outline for a Belgian row house renovation with two contractors and excavation work.
output: Draft health and safety plan: row house renovation.
Supplied facts: two contractors and excavation work.
Risk topics: excavation collapse, falls, and coordination between contractors.
Review items: excavation support, collective fall protection, and phase-specific responsibilities.
Missing information: site address, project owner, work sequence, and coordinator details.
Status: working draft requiring site-specific assessment and coordinator approval.

output_examples.input: Create a diary entry from these notes: north-side guardrail missing; contractor agreed to restore it; no deadline recorded.
output: Coordination diary: site visit date and project reference not supplied.
Agreement: contractor will restore the guardrail.
Responsible party: contractor name not supplied.
Follow-up: coordinator to verify restoration and record closure.

best_practices: Provide project dimensions, contractor roles, construction phases, and known site hazards before drafting.
Have a recognized coordinator verify proposed measures and current Belgian requirements before approving any document.
Keep missing facts explicit and record responsible parties, deadlines, and action closure in diary entries.
anti_patterns: Treating generated plans as approved documents or proof of regulatory compliance.
Copying example thresholds or protective measures without checking current rules and actual site conditions.
Assuming the public guide includes paid templates, automatic legal updates, or document management integrations.

faq.question: What does this package contain?
faq.answer: It contains one SKILL.md guide with descriptions, an example, and questions. Original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: Which documents can it help draft?
faq.answer: It guides drafting health and safety plans, coordination diary entries, and post-intervention dossiers for Belgian construction projects.

faq.question: Does it replace a recognized safety coordinator?
faq.answer: No. Generated documents are working drafts, and final responsibility and approval remain with the recognized coordinator.

faq.question: Are legal updates automatic?
faq.answer: The guide claims regular updates, but the reviewed package contains no automatic update mechanism. Verify current Belgian requirements independently.

faq.question: Can it determine whether coordination is required?
faq.answer: It can guide a preliminary assessment using project size, contractor count, and risks. A qualified professional must verify the conclusion.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes, as a text guide in a compatible assistant workflow. The reviewed package does not include a dedicated dashboard integration.
